description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples for the DetectFace operation for face detection and facial landmark localization
description_zh: 本文介绍人脸检测与五官定位DetectFace的语法及示例
name: DetectFace

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the China (Shanghai) region. For local files or OSS links in other regions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return facial landmark localization results. Valid values: true and false
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要返回人脸的特征点定位，取值true或false
parameters.name: landmark

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return face quality information. Valid values: true and false
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要返回人脸质量，取值true或false
parameters.name: quality

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return face pose information. Valid values: true and false
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要返回人脸的姿态，取值true或false
parameters.name: pose

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of faces to return in the image. Valid values: 1 to 30. Set this parameter correctly if you want to return multiple face detection results. Results are sorted in descending order by the FaceProbabilityList parameter by default
parameters.help_zh: 设置图片中人脸的最大返回数量，取值范围1~30。若想返回多个人脸检测结果，请正确设置。默认按返回参数FaceProbabilityList进行降序排列
parameters.name: max_face_number

items.description_en: The probability that the detected region contains a face. Valid values: 0 to 1. If multiple faces are detected, the probabilities are returned in sequence. For example, if two faces are detected, the response is `[face_prob1, face_prob2]`. A higher value indicates a larger face region, a clearer face, and a more frontal face in the image
items.description_zh: 截图中包含人脸的概率，取值范围0~1。如有多个人脸，则依次返回。例如有两个人脸则返回`[face_prob1, face_prob2]`。图像中人脸区域分辨率越大，人脸越清晰，人脸正视，对应的该值越大

items.description_en:
The face bounding boxes in the format `[left, top, width, height]`. If multiple faces are detected, the bounding boxes are returned in sequence. For example, if two faces are detected, the response is `[left1, top1, width1, height1, left2, top2, width2, height2]`.
left-top: The position of the upper-left corner of the bounding box relative to the upper-left corner of the image (x, y). The value x indicates the distance in pixels from the left edge of the image, and y indicates the distance in pixels from the top edge.
width-height: The width and height of the bounding box.
The area of the bounding box is width × height, and the lower-right corner coordinates are (left+width, top+height)
items.description_zh:
返回人脸矩形框，分别是`[left, top, width, height]`。如有多个人脸，则依次顺延，返回矩形框。例如有两个人脸则返回`[left1, top1, width1, height1, left2, top2, width2, height2]`。
left-top: 表示以图片左上角为坐标原点，目标框所对应的左上角点位置（x,y），表示框的第一个点距离图片左边界x像素，距离上边界y个像素。
width-height：表示目标框的宽和高。
目标框面积为width*height，目标框右下角坐标为（left+width,top+height）

LandmarkCount.description_en: The number of facial landmarks. Currently fixed at 105 points: 24 for eyebrows, 32 for eyes, 6 for the nose, 34 for the mouth, and 9 for the face contour
LandmarkCount.description_zh: 人脸特征点数目，目前固定为105点。依次为：眉毛24点，眼睛32点，鼻子6点，嘴巴34点，外轮廓9点

items.description_en: The comprehensive score for keypoint detection. Valid values: (0, 100]. A threshold of 85 is recommended. You can determine whether to set a threshold and the appropriate value based on your actual application scenarios in Settings. A higher score indicates better keypoint quality for the face, which is more favorable for recognition and can be used to filter face samples
items.description_zh: 关键点检测综合分值，取值范围(0, 100]，推荐采用85的阈值（您可以按实际应用场景判断设置阈值与否及相应阈值大小），该分值越大，对应脸的关键点的质量越好，越有利于识别，可用来筛选人脸样本

items.description_en: The facial landmark localization results. Each face returns a set of landmark positions in the format `(x0, y0, x1, y1, ...)`. If multiple faces are detected, the floating-point values are returned in sequence
items.description_zh: 人脸特征点定位结果，每个人脸返回一组特征点位置，表示方式为`（x0, y0, x1, y1, ……）`；如有多个人脸，则依次顺延，返回定位浮点数

items.description_en:
The face pose angles in the format `[yaw, pitch, roll]`. If multiple faces are detected, the values are returned in sequence.

yaw: The left-right angle. Valid values: -90 to 90.

pitch: The up-down angle. Valid values: -90 to 90.

roll: The in-plane rotation angle. Valid values: -180 to 180
items.description_zh:
返回人脸姿态角度，格式为`[yaw, pitch, roll]`。如有多个人脸，则依次顺延。

yaw为左右角度，取值范围-90~90。

pitch为上下角度，取值范围-90~90。

roll为平面旋转角度，取值范围-180~180

items.description_en: The center coordinates and radius of the left and right pupils. Each face has 6 floating-point numbers in the following order: `[left_iris_cenpt.x, left_iris_cenpt.y, left_iris_radius, right_iris_cenpt.x, right_iris_cenpt.y, right_iris_radis]`
items.description_zh: 左右两个瞳孔的中心点坐标和半径，每个人脸6个浮点数，顺序为`[left_iris_cenpt.x, left_iris_cenpt.y, left_iris_radius, right_iris_cenpt.x, right_iris_cenpt.y, right_iris_radis]`

Qualities.description_en: The face quality information. Higher scores indicate better suitability for recognition
Qualities.description_zh: 人脸质量情况，分数越高表示越有利于识别

items.description_en: The score indicating the impact of face blur on recognition. Higher scores indicate better suitability for recognition. Valid values: (0, 100]. If multiple faces are detected, the scores are returned in sequence. A threshold of 85 or higher is recommended for recognition. You can determine whether to set a threshold and the appropriate value based on your actual application scenarios in Settings. A score above 85 indicates a lower probability of image blur, while a score below 85 indicates a higher probability of image blur
items.description_zh: 人脸模糊度对识别的影响分数，分数越高越有利于识别，取值范围(0,100]。如有多个人脸，则依次顺延。在识别时，推荐设置阈值大于等于85（您可以按实际应用场景判断设置阈值与否及相应阈值大小），大于85代表图片模糊的概率越低，小于85代表图片模糊的概率越高

items.description_en: The score indicating whether the target is a face and its impact on recognition. Higher scores indicate better suitability for recognition. Valid values: (0, 100]. If multiple faces are detected, the scores are returned in sequence. A threshold of 85 or higher is recommended for recognition. You can determine whether to set a threshold and the appropriate value based on your actual application scenarios in Settings. A score above 85 indicates a higher probability that the image contains a face, while a score below 85 indicates a lower probability
items.description_zh: 目标是否为人脸及其对识别的影响分数，分数越高越有利于识别，取值范围(0,100]。如有多个人脸，则依次顺延。在识别时，推荐设置阈值大于等于85（您可以按实际应用场景判断设置阈值与否及相应阈值大小），大于85代表图片是人脸的概率越高，小于85代表图片是人脸的概率越低

items.description_en: The score indicating the impact of upper-face occlusion such as glasses on recognition. Higher scores indicate better suitability for recognition. Valid values: (0, 100]. If multiple faces are detected, the scores are returned in sequence. A threshold of 85 or higher is recommended for recognition. You can determine whether to set a threshold and the appropriate value based on your actual application scenarios in Settings. A score above 85 indicates a lower probability of wearing glasses, while a score below 85 indicates a higher probability
items.description_zh: 眼镜等上半脸遮挡对识别的影响分数，分数越高越有利于识别，取值范围(0,100]。如有多个人脸，则依次顺延。在识别时，推荐设置阈值大于等于85（您可以按实际应用场景判断设置阈值与否及相应阈值大小），大于85代表戴眼镜的概率越低，小于85代表戴眼镜的概率越高

items.description_en: The score indicating the impact of lighting on recognition. Higher scores indicate better suitability for recognition. Valid values: (0, 100]. If multiple faces are detected, the scores are returned in sequence. A threshold of 85 or higher is recommended for recognition. You can determine whether to set a threshold and the appropriate value based on your actual application scenarios in Settings. A score above 85 indicates a higher probability of good lighting, while a score below 85 indicates a lower probability
items.description_zh: 光照对识别的影响分数，分数越高越有利于识别，取值范围(0,100]。如有多个人脸，则依次顺延。在识别时，推荐设置阈值大于等于85（您可以按实际应用场景判断设置阈值与否及相应阈值大小），大于85代表图片光照好的概率越高，小于85代表图片光照好的概率越低

items.description_en: The score indicating the impact of lower-face occlusion such as masks on recognition. Higher scores indicate better suitability for recognition. Valid values: (0, 100]. If multiple faces are detected, the scores are returned in sequence. A threshold of 85 or higher is recommended for recognition. You can determine whether to set a threshold and the appropriate value based on your actual application scenarios in Settings. A score above 85 indicates a lower probability of wearing a mask, while a score below 85 indicates a higher probability
items.description_zh: 口罩等下半脸遮挡对识别的影响分数，分数越高越有利于识别，取值范围(0,100]。如有多个人脸，则依次顺延。在识别时，推荐设置阈值大于等于85（您可以按实际应用场景判断设置阈值与否及相应阈值大小），大于85代表戴口罩概率越低，小于85代表戴口罩概率越高

items.description_en: The score indicating the impact of image noise on recognition. Higher scores indicate better suitability for recognition. Valid values: (0, 100]. If multiple faces are detected, the scores are returned in sequence. A threshold of 85 or higher is recommended for recognition. You can determine whether to set a threshold and the appropriate value based on your actual application scenarios in Settings. A score above 85 indicates a lower probability of image noise, while a score below 85 indicates a higher probability
items.description_zh: 图片噪声对识别的影响分数，分数越高越有利于识别，取值范围(0,100]。如有多个人脸，则依次顺延。在识别时，推荐设置阈值大于等于85（您可以按实际应用场景判断设置阈值与否及相应阈值大小），大于85代表图片有噪声的概率越低，小于85代表图片有噪声的概率越高

items.description_en: The score indicating the impact of face pose on recognition. Higher scores indicate better suitability for recognition. Valid values: (0, 100]. If multiple faces are detected, the scores are returned in sequence. A threshold of 85 or higher is recommended for recognition. You can determine whether to set a threshold and the appropriate value based on your actual application scenarios in Settings. A score above 85 indicates a higher probability of a frontal face pose, while a score below 85 indicates a lower probability
items.description_zh: 姿态对识别的影响分数，分数越高越有利于识别，取值范围(0,100]。如有多个人脸，则依次顺延。在识别时，推荐设置阈值大于等于85（您可以按实际应用场景判断设置阈值与否及相应阈值大小），大于85代表人脸姿态正面的概率越高，小于85代表人脸姿态正面的概率越低

items.description_en: The comprehensive quality score. Higher scores indicate better suitability for recognition. Valid values: (0, 100]. If multiple faces are detected, the scores are returned in sequence. A threshold of 85 or higher is recommended for recognition. You can determine whether to set a threshold and the appropriate value based on your actual application scenarios in Settings. A score above 85 indicates high overall image quality, while a score below 85 indicates low overall image quality
items.description_zh: 质量综合分数，分数越高越有利于识别，取值范围(0,100]。如有多张人脸，则依次返回。在识别时，推荐设置阈值大于等于85（您可以按实际应用场景判断设置阈值与否及相应阈值大小），大于85代表图片综合质量越高，小于85代表图片综合质量越低
